versions.changelog:
- Added primaryEnv field specifying LEMLIST_API_KEY as the main environment variable for configuration.
- No functional or API changes; documentation improvement only.

Initial release—official integration for Lemlist API automation.

- Manage campaigns (create, list, pause, start, fetch stats)
- Add, update, remove leads; send messages via email, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, SMS
- Set up and manage webhooks for campaign events
- Configure schedules, manage unsubscribes, and export data
- Enrich leads, control Lemwarm, manage inbox labels and conversations
- Includes full setup, authentication, Python helper, and endpoint summaries
